meals.food: 3 large eggs with 1 yolk removed + 2–3 slices sourdough toast
meals.notes:
Toast quantity reported as 2–3 slices.
Portions: 2 whole large eggs (50g each) + 1 large white (33g); sourdough midpoint 2.5 slices at assumed 36g/slice (90g). No butter/oil or toppings assumed. USDA reference values: eggs 0.36g carbs/4.8g fat each, white 0.24g/0.06g, bread 51.9g carbs/2.4g fat per 100g. With 2–3 such slices: breakfast ~38.3–57.0g carbs, ~11.4–12.3g fat; actual thick slices/cooking fat may exceed range. Sources: https://tools.myfooddata.com/print/171287/wt1/1/1/ ; https://tools.myfooddata.com/nutrition-facts/172183/wt1 ; https://getpanelry.com/nutrition-facts/sourdough-bread

Portion: assume one ~237ml cup plain brewed black coffee, no milk/sugar. USDA generic brewed coffee: 0g carbs, 0.05g fat per 237g; ~178–355ml gives 0g carbs and ~0.04–0.08g fat (portion illustration, actual size/brewing unknown). Reference cup is ~2 kcal; logged 5 kcal retained. Source: https://tools.myfooddata.com/nutrition-facts/171890/wt3
